topics.purpose: Define the hard separation between stable identity, descriptive profile, authentication methods/session assurance, PortfolioCore evidence and MeritCore competence history.

semantics.identity_rule: Stable IdentityCore ID is the cross-layer anchor.
semantics.profile_rule: Profile fields can change without changing semantic identity.
semantics.credential_rule: Credential rotation/recovery does not change semantic identity.
semantics.authorization_rule: AccessCore evaluates rights independently from all descriptive profile fields.
semantics.projection_rule: A combined human profile/CV view may project all layers while preserving source ownership.

invariants.rule: IdentityCore owns stable person/organization identity and explicit identity relations; credentials, profiles, merits and authorization remain separate semantic layers.

hard_gates.condition: CV projection becomes canonical owner of all layers
MeritCore values copied into profile as authority

references.purpose: Merit remains identity-linked but separately owned.
